uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, identity_uuid, agent_external_id, revision, status, CAST(env AS text) AS env, CAST(vault_mounts AS text) AS vault_mounts, CAST(disabled_vaults AS text) AS disabled_vaults, created_at, updated_at

uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, channel_uuid, channel_external_id, scope_kind, platform_account, remote_id, display_name, status, identity_uuid, agent_external_id, agent_version, revision, pairing_code_expires_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM identities WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM identities WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{identityUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM identities WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{identityUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE identities SET namespace = #{params.Namespace}, external_subject_id = #{params.ExternalSubjectID}, display_name = #{params.DisplayName}, auto_memory_store = #{params.AutoMemoryStore}, updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE identities SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE identities SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_configs ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, identity_uuid, agent_external_id, env, vault_mounts, disabled_vaults ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.IdentityUUID}, #{params.AgentExternalID}, CAST(#{params.Env} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.VaultMounts} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.DisabledVaults} AS jsonb) ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM identity_configs WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND agent_external_id = #{agentExternalID} AND status = 'active'

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM identity_configs WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND status = 'archived') AS archived_configs, (SELECT count(*) FROM channel_pairings WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND status = 'unbound') AS unbound_pairings, (SELECT count(*) FROM channels WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND identity_resolution_mode = 'fixed' AND entry_closed = true AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS closed_entries
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_configs SET status = 'archived', updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND status = 'active'
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, uuid AS channel_uuid, external_id AS channel_external_id, identity_resolution_mode AS mode, identity_uuid, CAST(mounts ->> 'agent_version' AS integer) AS agent_version, execution_revision AS revision, connection_status, entry_closed, updated_at FROM channels WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{channelExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND identity_resolution_mode IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_pairings SET status = 'active', identity_uuid = #{params.IdentityUUID}, agent_external_id = #{params.AgentExternalID}, agent_version = #{params.AgentVersion}, revision = 1, pairing_code_hash = NULL, pairing_code_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE channel_pairings SET status = 'unbound', revision = revision + 1, pairing_code_hash = NULL, pairing_code_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND status = 'active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_actor_links ( organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, channel_type, app_id, actor_id, identity_uuid, personal ) VALUES ( #{organizationUUID}, #{workspaceUUID}, #{channelType}, #{appID}, #{actorID}, #{identityUUID}, true ) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, channel_type, app_id, actor_id) DO UPDATE SET identity_uuid = EXCLUDED.identity_uuid, personal = true, updated_at = now() WHERE NOT identity_actor_links.personal
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM identity_actor_links WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND personal ) AS owned
mapper.update: UPDATE sessions SET identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT b.session_uuid, b.session_external_id, b.identity_uuid, b.agent_external_id, b.binding_revision, b.config_revision, b.pairing_external_id, b.personal_vault_external_id, b.scope_kind, b.scope_key, b.channel_external_id, s.status AS session_status, b.created_at FROM session_identity_bindings b JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = b.session_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid WHERE b.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND b.session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT b.session_uuid, b.session_external_id, b.identity_uuid, b.agent_external_id, b.binding_revision, b.config_revision, b.pairing_external_id, b.personal_vault_external_id, b.scope_kind, b.scope_key, b.channel_external_id, s.status AS session_status, b.created_at FROM session_identity_bindings b JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = b.session_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid WHERE b.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND b.identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.session_uuid) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT b.agent_external_id) AS agents, MAX(s.updated_at) AS last_used_at FROM session_identity_bindings b JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = b.session_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid WHERE b.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND b.identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.updated_at >= #{since}

SELECT b.agent_external_id AS agent_external_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, MAX(s.updated_at) AS last_used_at FROM session_identity_bindings b JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = b.session_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid WHERE b.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND b.identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.updated_at >= #{since} GROUP BY b.agent_external_id ORDER BY last_used_at DESC, b.agent_external_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.external_id FROM session_identity_bindings b JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = b.session_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid WHERE b.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND b.identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND ( s.status IN ('running', 'rescheduling') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_tool_calls t JOIN code_sessions c ON c.uuid = t.code_session_uuid WHERE c.session_uuid = s.uuid AND c.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND t.oauth_wait_started_at IS NOT NULL AND t.finished_at IS NULL AND t.state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired', 'lost') ) )

WITH subjects AS ( SELECT uuid, external_id AS id, namespace, external_subject_id, display_name, enabled, created_at FROM identities WHERE organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL ), usage AS ( SELECT b.identity_uuid, b.agent_external_id AS agent_id, count(*) AS sessions, max(s.updated_at) AS last_used_at FROM session_identity_bindings b JOIN subjects i ON i.uuid = b.identity_uuid JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = b.session_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid WHERE b.organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND b.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY b.identity_uuid, b.agent_external_id ), identity_usage AS ( SELECT identity_uuid, count(*) AS agents, sum(sessions) AS sessions, max(last_used_at) AS last_used_at, max(last_used_at) >= now() - interval '7 days' AS active FROM usage GROUP BY identity_uuid ), directory AS ( SELECT i.id, i.namespace, i.external_subject_id, i.display_name, i.enabled, i.created_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_actor_links l WHERE l.identity_uuid = i.uuid AND l.personal) AS personal, coalesce(u.agents, 0) AS agents, coalesce(u.sessions, 0) AS sessions, u.last_used_at, coalesce(u.active, false) AS active FROM subjects i LEFT JOIN identity_usage u ON u.identity_uuid = i.uuid WHERE true AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM usage a WHERE a.identity_uuid = i.uuid AND a.agent_id = #{params.AgentID} ) AND u.active AND i.enabled AND NOT i.enabled AND ( strpos(lower(i.display_name), lower(#{params.Search})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(i.external_subject_id), lower(#{params.Search})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(i.id), lower(#{params.Search})) > 0 ) ), page AS ( SELECT id, namespace, external_subject_id, display_name, enabled, created_at, personal, agents, sessions, last_used_at, active FROM directory ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{params.Sort} = 'sessions' THEN sessions END DESC NULLS LAST, last_used_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC OFFSET #{params.Offset} LIMIT #{params.Limit} ), used_agents AS ( SELECT DISTINCT agent_id AS id FROM usage ), agent_options AS ( SELECT u.id, coalesce(a.name, u.id) AS name FROM used_agents u LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.external_id = u.id AND a.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'data', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{params.Sort} = 'sessions' THEN page.sessions END DESC NULLS LAST, page.last_used_at DESC NULLS LAST, page.id DESC) FROM page), '[]'::jsonb), 'total_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM directory), 'agent_options', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(agent_options) ORDER BY name, id) FROM agent_options), '[]'::jsonb), 'overview', jsonb_build_object( 'identities', (SELECT count(*) FROM subjects), 'active', (SELECT count(*) FROM identity_usage WHERE active), 'agents', (SELECT count(*) FROM used_agents), 'sessions', (SELECT coalesce(sum(sessions), 0) FROM identity_usage) ) )::text AS directory
mapper.sql: SELECT p.identity_uuid, p.channel_uuid, p.channel_external_id, p.agent_external_id, p.scope_kind, p.remote_id, p.external_id AS pairing_external_id, p.platform_account FROM channel_pairings p WHERE p.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND p.status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT c.identity_uuid, c.uuid AS channel_uuid, c.external_id AS channel_external_id, c.agent_external_id, 'fixed' AS scope_kind, '' AS remote_id, '' AS pairing_external_id, '' AS platform_account FROM channels c WHERE c.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND c.identity_resolution_mode = 'fixed' AND c.entry_closed = false AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WITH targets AS () SELECT i.external_id AS identity_external_id, i.display_name, t.channel_external_id, t.scope_kind, t.remote_id, t.pairing_external_id, 'active' AS status FROM targets t JOIN identities i ON i.uuid = t.identity_uuid AND i.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.agent_external_id = #{agentExternalID}

WITH targets AS () SELECT DISTINCT t.agent_external_id, c.external_id AS channel_external_id, c.channel_type, c.name, c.binding_status FROM targets t JOIN channels c ON c.uuid = t.channel_uuid AND c.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.identity_uuid = #{identityUUID} AND (t.scope_kind = 'fixed' OR t.platform_account = c.app_id) ORDER BY t.agent_external_id, c.name, c.external_id

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM channel_user_vaults p JOIN vaults v ON v.uuid = p.vault_uuid AND v.workspace_uuid = p.workspace_uuid WHERE v.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND v.external_id = #{vaultExternalID} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_cleanup_runs ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, identity_uuid, state, result ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.IdentityUUID}, #{params.State}, CAST(#{params.Result} AS jsonb) ) RETURNING external_id, state, CAST(result AS text) AS result, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_cleanup_runs SET state = #{state}, result = CAST(#{result} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID}
